2025-07-28-pulse.title: Explore traffic with Pulse
2025-07-28-pulse.description: Tracing page, Pulse strip above the table. Hover a bar to see its count, switch the metric dropdown from Count to Cost, click the highest cost bar to filter the table to that time window, then reset the time range to the past 30 days and the metric to Count.

2025-10-20-custom-model-definition-169.title: Add a custom model price from a generation
2025-10-20-custom-model-definition-169.description: Trace detail with a generation on model grok-4-fast that shows "no cost". Click the model badge in the generation header to open the "Create Model" dialog, prefilled with the model name, match pattern and usage types. Enter prices per unit for input and output, review the price preview and click "Submit". Langfuse opens the new model under Project Settings > Models.

2025-12-16-prompt-config.title: Add a model config to a prompt version
2025-12-16-prompt-config.description: Prompts > support-reply. Click "New version", set the JSON in the "Config" editor to model gpt-4.1 and temperature 0 and click "Save new prompt version". On the new version, open the "Config" tab to see the saved config.

2025-12-19-annotation-queues.title: Create and work an annotation queue
2025-12-19-annotation-queues.description: Human Annotation > "New queue": name it "Error Analysis", add the "First Pass" score config and click "Create queue". In Tracing, select three traces, choose "Add to Annotation Queue" in the selection bar and pick "Error Analysis". Open the queue with "Process queue" and annotate the first item in the Annotate panel.

2025-12-19-manual-scoring.title: Score a generation manually
2025-12-19-manual-scoring.description: Trace detail with a generation selected. Click "Annotate" in the observation header, use "Add score" to add the Accuracy and Helpfulness score configs, pick "Correct" for Accuracy and enter 4 for Helpfulness. Scores save automatically.

2026-03-06-add-llm-connection-v3.title: Add an LLM connection
2026-03-06-add-llm-connection-v3.description: Project Settings > "LLM Connections". Click "+ Project Connection", choose the LLM adapter (openai), enter a provider name (openai-support) and an API key, then click "Create connection"; Langfuse checks the key and the new connection appears under Project connections. "Show advanced settings" holds the base URL and custom models.

2026-03-10-demo-saved-views.title: Save a table view
2026-03-10-demo-saved-views.description: Tracing table. Search name:draft-reply latency:>2 to filter to slow replies, then open "My Views" > "Create Custom View", name it "Slow support replies" and click "Save View". Clear the search, and opening the saved view from "My Views" brings the filters back.

2026-06-17-create-multimodal-dataset-ite.title: Add an image to a dataset item
2026-06-17-create-multimodal-dataset-ite.description: Datasets > support-screenshots. Click "New item", type the input JSON, then use the attach (paperclip) button of the Input editor to upload a checkout screenshot; the editor inserts a media reference with an image preview. Click "Add to dataset" and the item appears in the list.

2026-06-19-filter-search-bar.title: Filter with the search bar
2026-06-19-filter-search-bar.description: Tracing page, search bar above the table. Type "level:" and pick WARNING from the observed values, add "metadata.scenario" with the value refund-request from the suggestions, then run a full-text search for "Happy to help" scoped to output. Each filter shows as a chip and narrows the table; clearing the bar restores the unfiltered table.

2026-07-13-graph-view-modes.title: Switch the agent graph between aggregated and expanded
2026-07-13-graph-view-modes.description: Trace detail of an agent trace, "Graph" tab next to Tree and Timeline. In the default Aggregated mode, repeated steps collapse into one node such as "llm.chat (3/3)"; select it to see its observations. Switch the toggle to Expanded to see the run as it happened, click a tool call node, then switch back to Aggregated.

2026-08-21-evaluator-code-setup.title: Set up a code evaluator
2026-08-21-evaluator-code-setup.description: Evaluators > "New evaluator" > browse templates, search for and pick "Detect User Frustration (ALL CAPS)" (TypeScript code evaluator). In "Test with sample observations", filter to the support chatbot's generations, select one and click "Run test on this sample" to see the score and comment. "Create evaluator" at the bottom right saves it.

2026-08-21-evaluator-llmaaj-setup.title: Set up an LLM-as-a-judge evaluator
2026-08-21-evaluator-llmaaj-setup.description: Evaluators > "New evaluator" > template "Classify Input Topic" (LLM-as-a-judge). Filter the sample observations to the support chatbot, map the {{input}} variable to payload.message under "Map variables to data", run the judge on one sample to see its score and reasoning, then click "Create evaluator" and confirm the rule in the "Evaluator saved" dialog.

2026-08-22-new-eval-experience.title: Set up online evaluation end to end
2026-08-22-new-eval-experience.description: Evaluators > "New evaluator" > LLM-as-a-judge template "Detect Out-of-Scope Request". Filter the sample to the support chatbot's generations, run the judge on one sample (score false with reasoning), click "Create evaluator" and, in the "Evaluator saved" dialog, reuse the configured filters as the rule for incoming observations.

250210-trace-log-level-filter.title: Show and hide DEBUG observations
250210-trace-log-level-filter.description: Trace detail of a LangGraph trace. The tree notes "5 hidden observations below DEFAULT level"; click "Show all" to reveal the DEBUG spans. Open the tree's "⋯" menu > "Min Level" and choose DEFAULT to hide them again.

250402-protected-prompt-labels.title: Protect prompt labels
250402-protected-prompt-labels.description: Project Settings > "Protected Labels". Pick production in "Select or enter a label" and click "Add", then do the same for staging. Only admins and owners can now set or remove these labels on prompts. Enterprise feature.

create-api-keys.title: Create API keys
create-api-keys.description: Project Settings > "API Keys" > "Create new API keys". Name the key, keep "Full access" and click "Create API key". The dialog shows the secret key (only shown once), the public key and the .env snippet with LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY, LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY and LANGFUSE_BASE_URL. After closing it, the key appears in the list.

create-dashboard.title: Create a dashboard
create-dashboard.description: Dashboards > "New dashboard": name it "Observation Performance", add a description and create it. On the new dashboard, set the time range to "Past 7 days", click "Add Widget" and pick the saved "Observation Latencies" widget, which renders as a line chart.

create-widget.title: Create a dashboard widget
create-widget.description: Dashboards > "Widgets" tab > "New widget". Keep the Observations view, set Metric to Latency with aggregation P 95, set "Breakdown Dimension" to Level, rename it "Observation Latencies" and click "Save Widget". The widget appears in the Widgets list.

dataset-item-create.title: Add a dataset item manually
dataset-item-create.description: Datasets > san-francisco-sites. Click "New item", enter the question "Which Art Deco tower stands on Telegraph Hill?" as Input and "Coit Tower" as Expected output, then click "Add to dataset". The item appears at the top of the Items table.

dataset-item-upload.title: Import dataset items from CSV
dataset-item-upload.description: An empty dataset > "Upload CSV": choose a CSV file, then drag the CSV columns input, expected_output and metadata onto the Input, Expected Output and Metadata fields under "Map to Dataset Items" and click "Import". The rows appear as dataset items.

datasets-add-from-trace.title: Add a generation to a dataset
datasets-add-from-trace.description: Trace detail with the generate-reply generation selected. Click "Add to" in the observation header > "Dataset" > support-replies. The "Add item to datasets" dialog opens prefilled with the generation's input and output as expected output; click "Add to dataset".

datasets-compare.title: Compare experiment runs
datasets-compare.description: Datasets > capital-cities > "Experiments" tab. Tick three experiments, click "Compare" in the selection bar to see each item's outputs and scores side by side, then click an output to open the item's trace in a side panel and select its generation.

deploy-prompt.title: Promote a prompt version to production
deploy-prompt.description: Prompts > qa-answer-with-context-chat with the latest version (#12) selected. Click "Add label", tick production under "Promote to production?" and click "Save and promote to production"; the production label moves to #12. The video then selects #9 and promotes it back to production.

download-chart-data-as-csv.title: Download widget data as CSV
download-chart-data-as-csv.description: Dashboards > Langfuse Cost Dashboard. Open the "⋯" menu of the "Total costs" widget and click "Download data as CSV".

full-text-search-launch.title: Find traces with full-text search
full-text-search-launch.description: Tracing page search bar: type "cracked bumper" and pick the full-text suggestion content:"cracked bumper" to search inputs and outputs. The table narrows to the matching rows; click one to open the generation in the peek panel.

overview-dashboard.title: Monitor traces, costs and scores on the dashboard
overview-dashboard.description: Home dashboard with traces by name, model costs and scores. Change the time range from "Past 1 day" to "Past 7 days", then scroll through observations by level, model usage and cost, user consumption, score trends and latency percentiles.

overview-sessions.title: Follow a conversation as a session
overview-sessions.description: Trace detail of one support-chat turn. Click the "session" badge in the trace header to open the session: every turn of the conversation in one view, with the user and assistant messages in order. Click the last turn in the list on the left to jump to it.

overview-timeline.title: Find slow steps in the timeline
overview-timeline.description: Trace detail of an agent trace. Switch from "Tree" to "Timeline" to see each step as a bar on a time axis with its duration and cost, so the slowest steps stand out. Click one of the llm.chat calls to open it, then switch back to "Tree".

overview-users.title: See traces and scores per user
overview-users.description: Users list with each user's first and last event, trace count, tokens and cost. Click a user to open their page with total observations, tokens and cost, their traces, and the "Scores" tab with every score on their traces.

pipecat-trace-16-9.title: Trace a Pipecat voice agent
pipecat-trace-16-9.description: Trace of a Pipecat phone call: a conversation span with one turn per exchange, each with stt, llm and tts steps. Select the second turn's llm generation to see the call history and reply, then its tts step, then switch to "Timeline" to see the three turns in sequence.

playground-open-generation.title: Open a generation in the playground
playground-open-generation.description: Trace detail with a qa-answer generation selected. Click "Add to" in the observation header > "Playground" > "Fresh playground"; the playground opens with the generation's system and user messages and model settings. Click "Submit" to rerun it.

playground-open-prompt.title: Open a prompt in the playground
playground-open-prompt.description: Prompts > movie-critic, version 3. Click "Playground" > "Fresh playground", fill the variables criticlevel (expert) and movie (Dune: Part Two) in the Variables panel and click "Submit" to get the model's answer in Output.

playground-save-prompt.title: Save a playground prompt to Prompt Management
playground-save-prompt.description: Playground with a chat prompt. Click "Save as prompt" in the window header > "Save as new prompt". The new-prompt form opens with the playground's messages; enter the name movie-critic-chat, keep "Set the production label" checked and click "Create prompt". It lands on version 1 with the production and latest labels.

playground-side-by-side-comparison.title: Compare prompts side by side in the playground
playground-side-by-side-comparison.description: Playground with one window. Click "New split window" to copy it, open the copy's "Variables" and change language from typescript to go, then click "Run All" to run both windows at once and compare their outputs. Close the copy with "Remove window".

playground-tool-calling.title: Call a tool from the playground
playground-tool-calling.description: Playground with a support system message and a customer question. Open "Tools" > "Create new tool", define get_order_status with a description and a JSON schema for order_id, and save it; the tool is attached to the window. Click "Submit": the Output shows the tool call with order_id A-21007.

project_menu.title: Switch organizations and projects
project_menu.description: Breadcrumb at the top left. Click the organization name (Acme Corp) to list your organizations and "New Organization", then click the project name (customer-support) to list the organization's projects and "New Project".

prompt-changes.title: Compare two prompt versions
prompt-changes.description: Prompts > support-reply with the latest version (#5) selected. Hover an older version in the version list and click its compare icon; the "Changes v2 → v5" dialog shows the content and config diff. Close it.

prompt-composability.title: Reference another prompt
prompt-composability.description: Prompts > qa-answer-with-context-chat > "New version". Click "Add prompt reference", choose the prompt guidelines, reference it by label production and click "Copy and close". Paste the copied @@@langfusePrompt tag into the user message, save the version, and open "Resolved prompt" to see the guidelines inlined.

prompt-create.title: Create a prompt
prompt-create.description: Prompts > "New prompt". Enter the name order-status-reply and a text prompt with the variables {{customer_name}} and {{order_id}}; Langfuse lists the detected variables below the editor. Keep "Set the production label" checked and click "Create prompt": version 1 opens with the production and latest labels.

prompt-experiments.title: Run a prompt experiment from the UI
prompt-experiments.description: Datasets > capital-cities > "Run experiment" > "via User Interface" > Configure. Select prompt answer-question, version 3, and model gpt-4.1, keep the dataset capital-cities, skip evaluators, name the run and click "Run Experiment". A toast confirms the experiment was triggered.

prompt-folders.title: Organize prompts in folders
prompt-folders.description: Prompts > "New prompt": name it onboarding/welcome-email (the slash creates a folder), enter the prompt text and click "Create prompt". Back in the Prompts list, the onboarding folder appears; open it to see welcome-email.

prompt-linking.title: See which prompt version a generation used
prompt-linking.description: Trace detail with a generation that used movie-critic v3. Click the prompt badge "movie-critic - v3" in the generation header to open the prompt, then open its "Linked Generations" tab and the "Metrics" tab with latency, cost and scores per version.

prompt-metrics.title: Compare prompt versions by metrics
prompt-metrics.description: Prompts > qa-answer-with-context-chat > "Metrics" tab: one row per version with median latency, input and output tokens, cost, generation count and score columns such as accuracy and helpfulness. Switch back with the "Versions" tab.

prompt-new-version.title: Save a new prompt version
prompt-new-version.description: Prompts > support-reply > "New version". Edit the system message, add the commit message "Confirm order numbers" and click "Save new prompt version". The new version appears on top of the version list with its commit message and the latest label.

score-analytics.title: Analyze scores
score-analytics.description: Scores > "Analytics". Pick helpfulness as the first score to see its statistics, trend over time and distribution, then pick faithfulness as the second score to compare both: means, matched pairs, correlation and a side-by-side distribution.

security-pii-redaction.title: Trace PII redaction around an LLM call
security-pii-redaction.description: Trace detail of a call-summary trace. Select the anonymize span to see names, emails and phone numbers replaced by placeholders, select the summarize generation that only sees the placeholders, then select the deanonymize span that restores the original values in the final output.

share-trace.title: Share a trace publicly
share-trace.description: Trace detail. Open the "⋯" (More actions) menu in the trace header and click "Make Public"; a toast confirms "Trace shared publicly" and that the link was copied. Reopening the menu now offers "Copy share link" and "Unshare".

trace-new-ui.title: Inspect a trace
trace-new-ui.description: Trace detail of a RAG answer with the generation selected. Hover the cost and token values in the generation header to see the cost and usage breakdowns, expand the collapsed chat history, then select the retrieval span in the tree to see the context it returned.

user-feedback-scores.title: Review user feedback scores
user-feedback-scores.description: Scores page. Search name:user-feedback value:<0.5 to list the thumbs-down feedback the chat widget sent through the API, with the customer's comment such as "Still charged twice." Click a row's trace to open the conversation in a side panel.
